Class ModularSolver

java.lang.Object
solvers.linearSystemSolver.Solver
solvers.linearSystemSolver.ParallelSolver
solvers.linearSystemSolver.ModularSolver
All Implemented Interfaces:
SolverInterface
public class ModularSolver extends ParallelSolver
Class which defines a ModularSolver object, which solves the linear system using residual systems solved by Gaussian elimination.
Author:
Michail Makaronidis, 2010

  • Method Details

    • initialise

      public void initialise(BigRational[][] A, List<Tuple<Integer,Integer>> UList, Set<Integer> uncomputables, int maxA, BigInteger maxb, BigRational maxG) throws OperationNotSupportedException, InternalErrorException
      Description copied from class: Solver
      Initialises the solver object, taking into account a list of positions of A that may need to be updated when requested. This is needed by the MoM algorithm. Furthermore, some bounds of the maximum elements contained in the linear systems (max A, max B, max Solution = max G) are given.
      Overrides:
      initialise in class Solver
      Parameters:
      A - The matrix A of the linear system Ax = b
      UList - The list containing these positions as Tuple objects
      uncomputables - The set of indices of possible zero-columns of A
      maxA - The maximum possible element in matrix A
      maxb - The maximum possible element of vector b
      maxG - The maximum possible legal solution value
      Throws:
      OperationNotSupportedException - Thrown when the matrix A is not square
      InternalErrorException - Thrown when any unrecoverable internal error is encountered during initialisation
